name: Stable Normal (Low Load)
description: Low concurrency and light requests (0.015s) establishing baseline latency with minimal queuing.

name: Dynamic Moderate Load
description: Balanced moderate concurrency (c=5) and standard processing (0.035s) creating realistic multi-node traffic.

name: Burst Traffic Spikes
description: Sudden wave of concurrent requests testing surge resilience, queue handling, and high-load model selection.

name: Sustained Stress Overload
description: High concurrency (c=14) and heavy compute duration (0.080s) inducing queue contention and backend saturation.

name: Priority Conflict & Contention
description: Interleaved high-priority relaxed requests with low-priority tight deadline requests under high contention.

name: Adaptive Multi-Phase Progression
description: Sequential 5-stage progression (Normal -> Moderate -> Burst -> Stress -> Recovery) demonstrating real-time model switching.

name: Steady State (Baseline)
Steady State (Legacy)
description: Uniform moderate arrival rate testing steady baseline response time and connection balancing.

name: Burst Traffic Spikes
Burst Traffic Spikes (Legacy)
description: Sharp sudden bursts of requests testing surge handling, queue management, and model reactivity.

name: Stress / High Load Overload
Stress / High Load Overload (Legacy)
description: High concurrency and heavy processing load testing saturation, thread starvation, and adaptive tree-model activation.

name: Mixed Priority & Deadlines
Mixed Priority & Deadlines (Legacy)
description: Heterogeneous request stream with LOW, NORMAL, HIGH, and CRITICAL requests under tight deadline envelopes.

name: High Contention & Priority Conflict
High Contention & Priority Conflict (Legacy)
description: Interleaved bursts with tight deadlines, testing EDF (Earliest Deadline First) and priority queue scheduling.
